    How the directory works

    First you find it.

    Search the register by place, region or status.

    Then you check the status.

    The source records active, in progress, planned and unmaintained portals.

    Next you see who builds it.

    Maintainers and repositories are linked where the register provides them.

    Finally, you build one.

    The Better LGU guide explains how to begin.

    The record, plainly.

    No invented figures, no unofficial endorsement, only what the public register says.

    ScopeNational SourcePublic register CheckedNov 19, 2026

    Better Ibaan takes the community-maintained Better LGU directory and makes it easy to read. It is named for Ibaan, Batangas, where one of the listed portals is based. The site is independent and is not operated by the municipality or by any listed LGU.

    Questions, answered.

    What is Better Ibaan?

    A community-maintained directory of Better LGU digital transparency portals across the Philippines. It helps people find public local information and the people who build it.

    Is this an official government site?

    No. It is an independent community project, not an official website of any municipality, province or agency. The name comes from Better Ibaan, one of the listed portals.

    Where does the data come from?

    Portal entries, statuses and regions are generated from the public better-lgu-directory register. The snapshot was checked on Nov 19, 2026 and the source is linked on every page.

    Can I start a portal without LGU permission?

    Yes. The canonical Better LGU guide says LGU permission is not required. It asks builders to register the intent as planned, use a community template and publish public data.

    What does open for adoption mean?

    It is a tag on entries where the community is looking for someone to take over. It is an invitation to help, not a verdict on the quality of a portal.

    What if a link is wrong or dead?

    The upstream register is public. You can open an issue there to propose a correction; this site will pick up the change on the next data sync.

    Better Ibaan is an independent community directory of Better LGU portals.

    Not an official government website. Data checked against public sources.
